notes.title: Nominate Gestalt for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers! This year, we’re thrilled to be part of the Steam Awards, and we’d love your support to help Gestalt: Steam & Cinder shine. Vote for us in these categories:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874404/96e441f64e674c754e8241828dde8041080ba7be.png[/img]

[h3]🎨 Outstanding Visual Style[/h3]
From the glowing forges of Fornax to the eerie depths of the Scrap Sea, Gestalt’s handcrafted steampunk world combines 16 and 32-bit inspiration with breathtaking modern artistry. If the Steam City of Canaan left you in awe, this is our category!

[h3]🏆 Labour of Love[/h3]
Every update, refinement, and new piece of content we’ve released reflects the passion we’ve poured into this game. If you’ve felt the care and dedication behind Gestalt, show your support here.

[h3]🎵 Best Soundtrack[/h3]
The music of Gestalt sets the stage for every battle and mystery, from haunting melodies to pulse-pounding themes. If our soundtrack struck a chord with you, help us get the recognition it deserves!

[h2]Nominate Now
[/h2]
Thank you for making this journey unforgettable. With your help, we can bring the Steam City of Canaan to even more players. Let’s make Gestalt a winner!

With gratitude,
The Gestalt: Steam & Cinder Team

notes.title: Of Rust and Ruin: Introducing the Voidwrought x Gestalt: Steam & Cinder Bundle
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that we’re collaborating with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/]Voidwrought[/url] to bring you all a brand new bundle!

Explore the ruins of ancient civilizations brought down under mysterious circumstances, navigate complex platforming with expert precision, and take on horrifying bio-mechanical beasts in the Steam & Ichor Bundle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874404/8ed958ad95a68aa5aeb30b081e7194786d12a4e1.png[/img]

[h2]The Steam & Ichor Bundle includes:[/h2]

Voidwrought, a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. You take on the role of the Simulacrum, a mysterious creature who has emerged from a cocoon with an unstoppable compulsion to collect Ichor, the blood of the gods. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

Gestalt: Steam & Cinder, a 2D action platformer inspired by 16 and 32-bit classics with exhilarating combat and an engrossing, twist-laden narrative all set in a stunningly handcrafted steampunk world. Join Aletheia and a vibrant cast of characters as they race to discover the secrets of the Steam City of Canaan. Fight for mankind’s survival and reveal the dark and dangerous truths riveted into the very foundations of the city.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231990/Gestalt_Steam__Cinder/

If you already own Voidwrought or Gestalt: Steam & Cinder, you’ll still be able to take advantage of the bundle. Instead of buying the full bundle, however, you’ll be given the option to complete the set and receive a 10% bundle discount on the other games, which will stack with any other discounts that are available on the games at the time.

Want to let us know your thoughts on our new bundle?


Join the conversation in our Discord and don’t forget to follow us on social media at [url=https://x.com/GestaltGame]@GestaltGame[/url] and [url=https://x.com/FireshineGames]@Fireshinegames[/url] for the latest updates!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/qMepFa9TmP]Join The Discord![/url]

notes.title: Community Update: Pre-launch FAQ
notes.content:
It’s almost time to join Aletheia on uncovering the long-buried secrets at the heart of Canaan… Gestalt: Steam & Cinder is releasing July 16th! 

In advance of launch day, we wanted to cover a few of your questions we’ve seen popping up. 

[h3][b]What will be the price of Gestalt: Steam & Cinder?[/b][/h3] 
For launch week, we’ll have a 10% discount. Normally, the price will be £15.99/$19.99. 

[h3][b]What’s the expected length of the game?[/b] [/h3]
10 – 12 hours if you’re looking to complete everything! 

[h3][b]How many Steam achievements are there?[/b] [/h3]
36 in total. 

[h3][b]Will Gestalt be Steam Deck Compatible?[/b] [/h3]
Yes!  

[h3][b]Which languages will the game be playable in?[/b] [/h3]
Gestalt: Steam & Cinder will be localized in the following languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese. 

We’re always open to hearing where there’s additional interest in localization and considering it with the team, but we can’t promise any additional languages at the moment. 

[b]If there’s anything else you’d like to find out, please let us know in the comments! [/b]

A huge thanks to everyone who has supported us over the years. We’re thrilled to be launching our game in less than two weeks, and can’t wait for you to finally forge Aletheia’s path through the rusting streets, lairs, and ruins of the Steam City. 

This world of ancient enmities, electrifying combat, and steam-shrouded lore awaits! 

--Metamorphosis Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874404/7f788529082066664fd8605bd2ed85eb3b00c448.gif[/img]

notes.title: Community Update: Release date change
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Firstly, [b]thank you so much[/b] for your ongoing support, especially those of you who have been here over the years. We really appreciate you bearing with us while we work on our game. 

That being said, we have an update about our release date. We're so close to the launch of Gestalt: Steam & Cinder, but we’re going to have to ask for a little more time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874404/61b18c20a37bd064b9031e7758080c307a0eeb2f.png[/img]

This has been a difficult decision to make, but what we thought would be our last round of testing has raised some unforeseen issues which we need a few extra weeks to iron out before launch. As a result, we’re moving the release date back to [b]16th July[/b] to deliver the very best version of the game that we can. 

Apologies that this isn't the news you would have wanted to hear, and we know this will be frustrating to some of you, but we want everyone to experience the game in the best possible way. We are so thankful for your continued patience - [b]we're almost there![/b]

If you have any questions do let us know, but please rest assured we are working really hard to get Gestalt: Steam & Cinder into your hands. 

Thanks again and talk soon, 

Metamorphosis Games

notes.title: Gestalt: Steam & Cinder - Developer Update!
notes.content:
[i][b]Deep in the scrap wastes of Canaan, legends thought forgotten echo through rust-eaten caverns as something ancient stirs in the dark...[/b][/i]

Hey everyone!

It’s been a little while since our last Steam update, but we’re excited to finally bring you more info and some deeper insight into the world of Gestalt: Steam & Cinder!

We’ve kicked off with a refresh of our Steam page, which is now packed with fresh details, shiny new gifs and more. But it doesn’t stop there – we have a few more surprises in the coming weeks. We can’t say anything else right now, but keep your eyes peeled…

Follow us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/gestaltgame?lang=en]@GestaltGame[/url]) for even more updates and weekly content from the game. notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We're so happy you seem to be enjoying the demo. We've implemented a few things to make sure that everyone gets the most out of the demo. 

Change log:
- Reload the gun on keyboard with 'O'.
- Additional tutorial text added (don't forget to roll through enemies!).
- Additional poultices added to Tartarus.

Thank you so much for playing. We cannot wait to show you the rest of Canaan later this year!

[h2][b]About the game[/b][/h2]

Inspired by 16 and 32-bit classics, Gestalt: Steam & Cinder fuses tight 2D platforming and exhilarating combat with an engrossing, twist-laden narrative in a stunningly handcrafted steampunk world.

Join Aletheia and a vibrant cast of characters as they find themselves embroiled in a race to discover the secrets of the massive, steam-powered city of Canaan, the last bastion of mankind. Unravel centuries-old conspiracies, battle hosts of monstrous automata and thwart the twisted schemes of the city’s corrupt overseers, the Comitium, as you fight for mankind’s survival and discover the dark truth of the Steam City’s origin.
